CheckTitle: Ensure Dormant Accounts and Orphaned Identities Are Reviewed and Disabled
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
RequiredAccess: Fusion pod REST with Basic Auth (ORACLE_FUSION_*), to run the ESS Inactive Users Report
Identity domain REST API (read-only admin app role, e.g. Audit Administrator + Security Administrator)
Description: Accounts unused for a defined period (for example 90 days) and accounts with no owner or assignment should be reviewed at least quarterly and disabled.
Risk: Forgotten accounts remain usable but unmonitored.
AuditProcedure: Generate user activity reports; identify accounts without sign-in for 90 days and accounts without roles, groups or owners.
Confirm they were reviewed and disabled where appropriate.

Steps: Set a dormancy threshold, schedule quarterly reviews and disable confirmed dormant or orphaned accounts.

DefaultValue: No review or disabling is enforced.
Notes: Uses the Fusion Inactive Users Report (ESS AseInactiveUsersJob) when ORACLE_FUSION_* is set, as security_platform does; otherwise the identity domain lastSuccessfulLoginDate. Dormant identity domain administrators are flagged as privileged. Accounts with no group are listed for review.
